title: Clinical Documentation
description: Redact PHI from clinical notes, discharge summaries, and care plans for quality improvement, training, or case studies while preserving medical context.

title: Medical Research
description: Prepare patient data for research studies, clinical trials, and publications while maintaining HIPAA compliance and patient anonymity.

title: Insurance & Billing
description: Protect patient information in insurance claims, prior authorization requests, and billing documentation while maintaining necessary medical details.

title: Patient Portals
description: Automatically redact sensitive information when sharing medical records with patients, family members, or authorized representatives through patient portals.

title: Legal & Compliance
description: Prepare medical records for legal proceedings, malpractice cases, or regulatory investigations while protecting uninvolved patient information.

title: Quality Improvement
description: Create de-identified datasets for quality improvement initiatives, outcome analysis, and population health studies.
